functions.name: SpawnIdToTableIndex
functions.notes: Not in .public -> static. Asserts 1 <= spawnId <= 0x1e (GF_ASSERT(spawnId > 0 && spawnId <= 30), falls back to 1 on failure via assert-fail path: GF_AssertFail then r0=1), returns spawnId - 1. Likely written as `if (id <= 0 || id > 30) { GF_AssertFail(); id = 1; } return id - 1;` — match the cmp/ble + cmp #0x1e/bls shape.

functions.name: GetMomSpawnId
functions.notes: Returns constant 1 (mom's house spawn). Prototype already in include/unk_0203BA5C.h as u16 — keep it (callers src/blackout.c:229 and src/save_local_field_data.c:49 already compiled against it).

functions.name: GetFlyWarpData

struct_accesses.meaning: Location.warpId = -1 (asm computes via reusing the row-stride constant register)

functions.notes: Not yet in include/unk_0203BA5C.h — add. No entry narrowing of r0, so u16 vs int both viable at callee; asm callers (asm/unk_02067A60.s:441, asm/overlay_02_02248728.s:8701) pass an already-narrowed u16. Sibling GetDeathWarpData is declared u16 in the existing header; mirror that.

functions.name: GetDeathWarpData

struct_accesses.meaning: Location.x = low byte of packed u16 at table offset 4; asm rereads the u16 and does lsl#0x18/lsr#0x18
Location.y = high byte of same u16; lsl#0x10/lsr#0x18

functions.notes: known_prototype in include/unk_0203BA5C.h:7 — do not change (src/blackout.c:200 compiled against it). The x/y extraction loads the same u16 field twice; two consecutive ldrh of [r1,#4] suggests a single u16 field read twice with shifts, or u8 fields accessed via the u16. Match by experiment.

functions.name: GetSpecialSpawnWarpData
functions.notes: known_prototype in include/unk_0203BA5C.h:8 — do not change (src/blackout.c:201). Body byte-identical in shape to GetFlyWarpData with field offsets 12/14/16.

functions.name: MapHeader_GetSpawnIdForDeathWarp
functions.notes: known_prototype in include/unk_0203BA5C.h:9 — do not change (src/field_warp_tasks.c:206). Linear scan i=0..29: if sSpawnMaps[i].deathSpawnMapNo == mapId && isBlackoutSpawn bit (bit 8 of first u16; lsl#0x17/lsr#0x1f) return i+1; else return 0. Leaf with two scan pointers (r3 advances for the offset-2 field, r4 for offset 0) — likely a single entry pointer accessed via two fields; MWCC duplicated the induction pointer.

functions.name: sub_0203BB50
functions.notes: Same scan, no flag check: returns i+1 where sSpawnMaps[i].flyPointMapNo == mapId, else 0. Equivalent to MapHeader_GetSpawnIdForFlyWarp. Caller asm/unk_02067A60.s:433 passes ldrh-loaded mapId and narrows result to u16 caller-side, so return type u32/int.

functions.name: FlypointFlagAction
functions.notes: Scan i=0..29: if sSpawnMaps[i].flyPointMapNo == mapId && isFlyPoint bit (bit 9 of first u16; lsl#0x16/lsr#0x1f): Save_VarsFlags_FlypointFlagAction(Save_VarsFlags_Get(fieldSystem->saveData), FLAG_ACTION_SET, sSpawnMaps[i].flagIdx & 0xff) then return (early-out via pop). Flag arg recomputed via fresh i*0x12 re-index into table base rather than reusing the scan pointer — write it as a fresh array access. Callers asm/unk_02067A60.s:58,106 pass (fieldSystem, fieldSystem->location->mapId).

data.label: sSpawnMaps
data.shape_guess: static const SpawnMap[30], 0x12 bytes each: u16 packed (flagIdx:8 | isBlackoutSpawn:1<<8 | isFlyPoint:1<<9), u16 deathSpawnMapNo, u16 deathSpawnX|deathSpawnY<<8, u16 flyPointMapNo, u16 flyPointX, u16 flyPointY, u16 specialWarpMapNo, u16 specialWarpX, u16 specialWarpY; map IDs from constants/maps.h

fields.meaning: flagIdx (low 8 bits) | isBlackoutSpawn (bit 8) | isFlyPoint (bit 9) — bitfield extraction lsl/lsr pattern strongly suggests bitfields (u16 flagIdx:8, isBlackoutSpawn:1, isFlyPoint:1)
deathSpawnX | deathSpawnY<<8 (read as one ldrh twice, extracted by shifts)

risks: include/unk_0203BA5C.h already exists with prototypes for GetMomSpawnId/GetDeathWarpData/GetSpecialSpawnWarpData/MapHeader_GetSpawnIdForDeathWarp compiled into src/blackout.c, src/field_warp_tasks.c, src/save_local_field_data.c — changing those signatures breaks IPA codegen of already-matched files; only ADD GetFlyWarpData/sub_0203BB50/FlypointFlagAction
rodata sSpawnMaps precedes .text — declare the static const table before the functions; single rodata symbol so ordering is trivial

Get*WarpData accessors use pool constants sSpawnMaps+6/+8/+10 etc. (field-base + i*0x12 ldrh [base, rIdx]) — MWCC's natural lowering for sSpawnMaps[idx].field where idx*sizeof is computed once; do not pre-take a row pointer for those fields
warpId = -1 materialized by reusing the 0x12 stride register (sub rN, #0x13) — field assignment ORDER in C may need experimentation
GetDeathWarpData reads the packed x/y halfword twice rather than caching — avoid a local temp
FlypointFlagAction recomputes the table index for the flag byte instead of reusing the scan pointers — use array indexing for the flagIdx access, pointer(s) for the scan comparisons
loop bound is 0x1e (30) with `blo` — unsigned counter (u32 i)
notes: Spawn-point table module (fly/death/special-warp spawn data). 8 thumb functions, ~0x150 bytes text + 540 bytes rodata at 0x0203BA5C. SpawnIdToTableIndex is the only static. Suggested header additions: void GetFlyWarpData(u16 spawnId, Location *dest); u32 sub_0203BB50(u32 mapId); void FlypointFlagAction(FieldSystem *fieldSystem, u32 mapId). No DECL_CHUNK_EX entries reference this file. Remaining asm callers: asm/unk_02067A60.s, asm/overlay_02_02248728.s.
